title: Live Lyrics on CarPlay iOS 27 Car Karaoke #shorts
description:
Live lyrics on CarPlay: turn your iOS 27 CarPlay dashboard into a car karaoke screen with CarPlay widgets.

Sing along with synced lyrics on a custom CarPlay dashboard while you drive. Perfect for road trips and morning commutes.

CarPlay tips for drivers in the USA: Chicago, Dallas, Seattle, Atlanta.

Search Car Widgets: AutoDash on the App Store.
